notes: 2.42 login app sequence: GET /dhis-web-login/ (static app) -> GET /api/loginConfig (unauthenticated) -> POST /api/auth/login JSON {username,password[,twoFactorCode]} -> on loginStatus SUCCESS the app navigates to redirectUrl.
Response body only {loginStatus, redirectUrl}. Session cookie name on this instance is JSESSIONID_agent-facility-hub (instance-configured; default DHIS2 is JSESSIONID) — the hub must not hardcode it.
redirectUrl is '/' here (no prior saved request).
